page.overview:
What is Kick Axe?

The Kick Axe is an axe-like weapon used by Jarek in Mortal Kombat: Armageddon, and it replaces his Black Dragon Sword from his first appearance in MK4. The construction of this heavy axe is of wood, leather, bronze banding, and a stainless steel blade. It has medievel origins, as it is a personal preference of Jarek.
